desc:
🏨 MOTEL Simulator – Build, Manage & Grow! 🏨

Start with a tiny two-room motel and turn it into a booming business! Manage guests, expand your property, and make strategic upgrades to attract more customers and increase your earnings. 

✅ Upgrade your motel from a small roadside stop to a luxury getaway
✅ Hire staff to keep things running smoothly while you focus on expansion
✅ Unlock new money-making methods beyond just renting out rooms
✅ Expand your motel to create the ultimate guest experience
✅ Shop System Sell items to NPCs, restock shelves, and watch your profits soar.
✅ Auto Save
